entities.summary: Master Mateo was a sculptor and architect who worked in medieval Christian kingdoms of the Iberian Peninsula during the second half of the twelfth century. He is best known now for the Pórtico da Gloria of the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela. He was also responsible for the Stone choir of Master Mateo of the cathedral in 1200, later torn down in 1603.
